# Compute keep/remove sets for song library and album library

# Assumes: liked_song_ids, downloaded_song_ids, liked_album_ids, song_library, album_library exist

keep_song_ids = set()
for s in song_library:
    sid = s['song_id']
    if sid in liked_song_ids or sid in downloaded_song_ids:
        keep_song_ids.add(sid)

remove_song_ids = [s['song_id'] for s in song_library if s['song_id'] not in keep_song_ids]

# Albums
keep_album_ids=set();
for a in album_library:
    aid=a['album_id']
    liked = aid in liked_album_ids
    downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_song_ids for sid in a.get('song_ids', [])) if a.get('song_ids') is not None else False
    if liked or downloaded:
        keep_album_ids.add(aid)

remove_album_ids=[a['album_id'] for a in album_library if a['album_id'] not in keep_album_ids]

print('song_library_total',len(song_library))
print('keep_song_ids',len(keep_song_ids))
print('remove_song_ids',len(remove_song_ids))
print('remove_song_ids_list',sorted(remove_song_ids))

print('keep_album_ids',len(keep_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids',len(remove_album_ids))

# Remove songs from Spotify song library that are neither liked nor downloaded
remove_results=[]
for sid in remove_song_ids:
    res=apis.spotify.remove_song_from_library(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    remove_results.append((sid,res))
    print('removed_song',sid,res)
print('total_song_removals_attempted',len(remove_results))

# Remove albums from Spotify album library that are neither liked nor fully downloaded
album_remove_results=[]
for aid in remove_album_ids:
    res=apis.spotify.remove_album_from_library(album_id=aid, access_token=spotify_token)
    album_remove_results.append((aid,res))
    print('removed_album',aid,res)
print('total_album_removals_attempted',len(album_remove_results))

# Verification: re-fetch song and album libraries and ensure removed items are gone

# Re-fetch song library
song_library_after=[]
page_index=0; page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    song_library_after.extend(res)
    page_index+=1
song_after_ids=set(x['song_id'] for x in song_library_after)

# Re-fetch album library

while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=spotify_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not res:
        break
    album_library_after.extend(res)
    page_index+=1
album_after_ids=set(x['album_id'] for x in album_library_after)

print('song_library_before_total',len(song_library))
print('song_library_after_total',len(song_library_after))

# Also compute keep sets present
